screens.description: Marketing landing page hero section with headline, CTA buttons, and a sample resume analysis card.
Marketing landing page call-to-action section ('Ready to see your career clearly?') with primary and secondary buttons.
Marketing landing page features grid highlighting modules like ATS analysis, interview simulator, code arena, skill roadmap, and portfolio audit.
Login screen (light) with email/password and social sign-in options.
Create account / signup screen (dark) with Google sign-in and email-based registration fields.
Dashboard overview showing overall score, ATS compatibility, missing keywords, and skill gaps with quick actions.
Keyword semantic analysis screen with matched vs missing keywords, target keyword spectrum chips, and an AI optimization panel.
Resume AI rewrite screen with a central empty state and a primary action to generate an AI rewrite.
Skill roadmap screen showing a recommended learning path, progress stats, and a list of roadmap items.
Q&A prep screen listing technical questions with expandable rows and sample answers.
Q&A prep screen with STAR answer drafts (Situation/Task/Action/Result) in stacked cards.
Mock interview setup screen (step 01) to configure session: interview mode, language, and input method (voice/text).
Mock interview screen (step 02) showing AI interviewer recommendation and a 'Ready to begin?' card with 'Enter Simulation' CTA.
Alternate mock interview screen view of the AI interviewer recommendation + 'Ready to begin?' section (layout variant).
Mock interview setup screen with the language dropdown open (JavaScript/TypeScript/Python/etc.).
Portfolio audit screen prompting for a GitHub URL and a button to analyze the portfolio.
History screen listing past applications/analyses with match score, ATS checks, and 'Review Match' actions.
Settings screen (account) showing profile info and editable fields plus theme selection controls.
Settings screen (notifications & security) with toggles, 2FA entry, active sessions, and data/privacy management.
Help & support screen with support contact options and an FAQ list.
